title: iliocostalis T11 EMG (L & R) holding 14 kg at 4 heights x 4 asymmetry angles

quantity.name: normalised EMG
quantity.definition: surface EMG RMS (30-450 Hz band-pass, 50 ms RMS window) averaged over the static holding period, normalised to the maximal RMS recorded during isometric MVEs in 6 directions (flexion, extension, L/R lateral bending, L/R axial rotation) in a semi-seated triaxial dynamometer (Ghezelbash 2018a); mean ± SD across subjects

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Ouaaid Z, Plamondon A, Arjmand N
source.sample: healthy asymptomatic young adults, in vivo (same cohort as Ghezelbash 2018 MVE study); file in donwload/ is misnamed 'Mitutoyo Digital Caliper - Certificate of Calibration Control # DDE14R52L.PDF' (IRSST accepted manuscript)

protocol.summary: Upright stance, knees straight; subjects statically held a 14 kg load (both hands) at 4 load heights (mid-tibia, knee, mid-femur, umbilicus='Upright') and 4 asymmetry angles A=0,30,60,90 deg to the subject's LEFT, load at fixed horizontal distance 0.2xBH from feet; each task performed once; EMG averaged over the hold. 14 surface electrodes bilateral (longissimus T11, iliocostalis T11 & L3, multifidus L4, RA, EO, IO). Hand loads of 2, 6, 10 kg were also recorded but only 14 kg EMG is reported (Figs 5-6).
how_to_simulate: Use subject_model (or each subject sex group); posture: trunk flexed to reach the load at the given height without knee bending (trunk flexion per height not tabulated; T11/S1 rotation regressions vs flexion F and asymmetry A in Table 2)
Rotate the trunk/pelvis toward the subject's left by asymmetry angle A (0/30/60/90 deg)
Apply 14 kg (137 N) shared by both hands at horizontal distance 0.2xBH from the feet at the given height

Compare predicted activation of the iliocostalis T11 fascicles closest to the left and right electrode with the %MVC value for each side; for the paper's model comparison, activation = mean of muscles closest to the electrode

subject_model.sex: mixed (9F,10M); simulate each sex or a sex-weighted mean subject
subject_model.source: Ghezelbash 2020 Methods lines 46-48 (identical to Ghezelbash 2018 Methods)

protocol.notes: Electrode vertical levels from Fig 5/6 legends; exact lateral distances not given here (Ghezelbash 2018 Fig 1 shows schematic placements, citing De Foa 1989 and McGill 1991). Asymmetric lifts were always to the left, so right/left are contra/ipsilateral respectively. Model results in Figs 5-6 (blue bars) are NOT data. 'Upright' in the figure labels is taken as the umbilicus-level hold (Methods list mid-tibia, knee, mid-femur, umbilicus; figure caption lists upright, mid-femur, knee, mid-tibia) - an inference.

extraction.from: Fig 5 (middle row, grey bars) (IRSST manuscript p.26-27)
extraction.uncertainty: mean ±1 %MVC (bar charts at 300 dpi, axis-calibrated from gridlines 0-100); SD ±1.5 %MVC (whisker tops)
extraction.check_notes: Bar tops and whisker tops located by pixel analysis against gridlines; values cross-checked visually against 150-dpi render (e.g. MF-L Mid-Femur-0 ≈41, EO-L Upright-90 ≈10). Black (L3) bars whose whisker was not auto-detected were re-measured by an independent column scan (5 bars). Bars and whiskers only show +1 SD.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD per side and task; also check trend across height and asymmetry

shared_sample_with: msk_mvc_coupled.ghezelbash2018 (all tests; same 19 subjects, MVEs used for normalisation)
